summary: Retire game_dialogs sheet 001 (Game2) for kit pieces
author: pm
body:
Retire game_dialogs sheet 001 (InterfaceNdGame2). The user, 2026-11-25: "001 - The kit should have all of these".

Live uses (grep, 2026-11-25) and their kit replacements:

| Frame | Look | Used in | Kit piece |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | square down button (geometry only) | dialog_box_sys_menu.cpp:344 slider knob rect | constants, or btn_sq_down's size |
| 19 / 20 | square + / - | dialog_box_shop.cpp:427-460 | btn_sq_plus / btn_sq_minus |
| 23 / 24 | round up / down, tinted dark when disabled | dialog_box_manufacture.cpp:308-313 | btn_round_up / btn_round_down (and _dark) |
| 25 / 26 | small up / down arrows | dialog_box_skill.cpp:81-82 | arrow_up_small / arrow_down_small |
| 27 | 26 px ring (slot marker) | dialog_box_manufacture.cpp:404, 523 | ring_bevel_26 |

**Done when:**
- every use draws the kit piece at the same place, keeping enabled and disabled looks;
- InterfaceNdGame2 is removed from sprite_id.h and screen_loading.cpp;
- sprite 1 of game_dialogs is an empty placeholder, and 001.png is archived byte-identical to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/;
- both builds are clean and in-client screenshots of the shop, manufacture, skill and system menu are attached.

The HH-0079 rows for sheet 001 close with this.
